page.layout: One column of text, with no marginal notes. Printed page 629 at the top right. Signature "Rr 3" at the foot. A catchword in Arabic sits below the last line, at the lower left.

p.i: vos, Obseruate Canones Apostolicos, & Homologiam hanc, & intelligite, quod signum hoc adorandae Crucis testimonium futurum sit inter me, & vos in die Iudicij, si quippiam iftorum mutauritis, & dicent Amen, Amen.

main_text.p: Item Daniel in Breuiario Conftitutionum Ecclesiae Iacobitarum, capite 7. de Canone librorum, post sacras Paginas Patrum recenset libros.

p.i: Ex libris quoque receptis sunt libri Antistitum[?], nempe Praefulum Religionis, uti sunt Athanasij, Cyrilli, Gregorij Theologi, Ioannis Chrysostomi, & aliorum huius notae.

main_text.p: Ex Cophtitis. Abnal-haffal in Praefatione Collectionis Can. & Conftit. Ecclesiae Alexandrinae, postquam pluribus differuit de traditionibus Apostolicis, haec subdit:
main_text.l: والاصل المعتمد عليه في جملة هذا المعنى هو قول ربنا له المجد لتلاميذه[?]

page.notes: Arabic lines are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; letters and dots in several words are uncertain and marked [?]. The Latin word "Antistitum" is read from a worn "ft" ligature and is marked [?]. The catchword "باسم" is at the lower left, not the right, and is marked [?]. "mutauritis" is set with a gap before "ritis" in the print and is copied as one word.
